market_name: Will the Iranian regime fall before 2027?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether crude futures and USO are already moving with the market probability; scan headlines for strikes/attacks on Iranian infrastructure or Hormuz incidents.
time_plan.1h: Confirm whether the probability move is driven by a genuine escalation event vs. noise; watch Brent-WTI spread and tanker rate chatter.
time_plan.2h: Assess persistence of the oil move and whether OPEC spare-capacity or SPR-release commentary is capping it.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against overnight/other-session liquidity; check if diplomatic de-escalation signals have reversed the premium.
time_plan.12h: Mark the realized move vs. prediction; determine whether the escalation narrative held or faded and whether sanctions-relief (bearish) narrative emerged.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of the Iranian regime falling almost always coincides with acute escalation (Israeli/US strikes, internal collapse risk) that threatens Iranian crude exports and raises fear of Strait of Hormuz disruption. Supply-risk premium flows directly into crude. The near-term chaos path dominates the longer-term 'sanctions relief, more barrels' narrative over a 12h window, so the immediate reaction is upward. Oil is the cleanest, most liquid proxy for Middle East escalation.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check gold spot and GLD against DXY and real yields to isolate the safe-haven bid.
time_plan.1h: Verify whether the move is risk-off driven or offset by a stronger dollar/higher yields.
time_plan.2h: Watch equity-index risk sentiment (SPX, VIX) to confirm broad risk-off supporting gold.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether safe-haven flows persist or mean-revert as the session matures.
time_plan.12h: Mark realized gold move; note whether it tracked the escalation premium in oil.

predictions.reasoning: Rising odds of Iranian regime collapse signal geopolitical instability and conflict risk, which drives safe-haven demand into gold. The move is typically smaller and slower than oil but directionally reliable during Middle East escalation. Below the 700bps tradable threshold, so flagged as non-tradable but informative.

evidence_used: Market question ties resolution to collapse/overthrow of the Islamic Republic, a military_conflict/Middle East topic
Historical pattern: Iran escalation events (strikes, Hormuz threats) spike crude and gold
Iran is a major oil producer and sits astride the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint
uncertainty_notes: A probability spike may reflect speculation/noise rather than a real escalation event
Direction could invert if regime-fall odds rise on a controlled, non-violent path implying future sanctions relief and more oil supply (bearish crude)
Oil/gold already price substantial geopolitical risk; incremental move may be muted
OPEC spare capacity and SPR releases can cap oil upside quickly

llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied probability that the Iranian regime falls most plausibly reflects acute Middle East military escalation, which raises the oil supply-risk premium (Hormuz, Iranian exports) and safe-haven demand. The cleanest liquid proxies are crude oil (USO, up, potentially tradable on a large escalation) and gold (GLD, up, smaller). The thesis is only moderate-confidence because a probability move can be noise, and a peaceful/relief path to regime change would be bearish for oil.
key_assumptions: A sharp probability move coincides with real-world escalation news, not pure speculation
The 12h reaction prioritizes supply-disruption fear over longer-term sanctions-relief/supply-return narrative
Oil and gold have not already fully priced the escalation before the market signal
failure_modes: Move reverses if de-escalation/diplomacy headlines follow
Information was already public and priced into oil/gold before the market moved
Weak proxy exposure if regime-fall odds rose on a peaceful transition implying eventual Iranian oil return (bearish crude, opposite direction)
Dollar strength/rising yields offset the gold safe-haven bid
Expected oil move falls short of the 700bps tradable threshold absent a major supply event
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
